title: Applying a build-mode saved view while already on the Build Query tab re-initializes the builder
verifies: the savedBuildConfig watch re-runs initializeFromQuery so an already-open build tab reflects the applied saved view's chart

title: Applying a build-mode saved view from the Logs tab opens the Build tab restored
verifies: the onMounted path flips to the build tab and restores the saved builder chart

title: Applying a saved view with no buildData re-derives instead of restoring a saved chart
verifies: a saved view with no buildData falls back to re-deriving the default builder instead of restoring a phantom chart

title: Re-applying the same build-mode saved view on the build tab restores again
verifies: a fresh savedBuildConfig re-fires the watch so re-applying the same view restores it each time

title: Toggling away and back after applying a build-mode view re-derives the builder instead of restoring the saved chart
verifies: on re-toggle the builder re-derives from the current query rather than re-applying the saved chart type
